data.title: 青山七海 · 客厅台本练习被夸奖的关西脸红
data.description: 放学后樱花庄榻榻米客厅里，七海正认真握着声优台本练习对白。当你在旁边真诚鼓掌并夸奖她声音真好听时，少女立刻手足无措地拿台本挡住脸，关西腔结结巴巴地娇嗔。
data.location: traditional Japanese tatami living room with Kotatsu
data.action: sitting on tatami holding a script, hiding burning flushed face behind the papers, blushing ears poking out through ponytail
data.lighting: soft afternoon light through paper shoji screens
data.mood: adorable Kansai dialect tsundere, pure earnest effort, heart-fluttering praise reaction
data.promptProse: Sitting on tatami holding a script, Nanami Aoyama hides her burning blushing face behind papers, embarrassed by sweet partner praise.
data.animaCaption: Nanami Aoyama hiding blushing face behind script on tatami.
